scripts.name: Cross-Sell Intro
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner sends; Both -> Cortney (auto-flip w/ manual override); named bandana whales stay Shara.
scripts.subject: a thought on your [PROJECT NAME] run
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
Your [PRODUCT] came out great. If you ever want [matching APPAREL/MERCH] to go with it, my teammate Cortney runs our apparel side, and she can pull a quick mockup so you can see it. I've copied her here so you have her.
No pressure, just a thought. Either way, glad we got to make these for you.
scripts.firesWhen: Week 2 for New Customers (T1 folds into QC call; T2 = this email). Introduces the other product line.
scripts.notes: v2 (2026-07-08): names Cortney + always cc team@. Live Gmail thread search decides reply-vs-new per send. Reverse = Xsell_Ban for apparel->bandana.

scripts.name: Cross-Sell Response
scripts.sentByRule: Cortney sends when a customer bites on the intro, within 1 business day.
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
Cortney here, I run the apparel side at Planet Apparel. Shara passed your note over and that mockup offer is real, I'd love to put it together for you.
One question so it's worth your time: what would your crew actually use, shirts, hats, hoodies, something else? Tell me that and I'll have your [PROJECT NAME] art worked up on it within a couple days.
No cost and no commitment. If it looks right, we'll talk numbers.
scripts.firesWhen: When a customer replies to the Cross-Sell Intro. Reply in the intro thread, no new subject.
scripts.notes: Approved 2026-07-08. Shelby angle: speak-their-own-sale + game-plan clarity + reason-first opener.

scripts.name: Cross-Sell Ghost Follow-Up
scripts.sentByRule: Cortney sends ONE light touch ~1 week after a bite goes quiet, then stops.
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
That apparel mockup is still yours if you want it. One line back gets it moving.
And if this isn't the season for it, that's an easy no. Tell me to sit tight and I will, no follow-up chain coming your way.
Glad we got to be part of the [PROJECT NAME] run either way.
scripts.firesWhen: ~1 week after a cross-sell bite goes quiet. One touch only; if no reply, mark the box and stop.
scripts.notes: Approved 2026-07-08. Anti-sell pull-back; we honor the 'no follow-up chain' promise by actually stopping.

scripts.name: Value Mockup
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner sends; usually Cortney (it's an apparel mockup).
scripts.subject: Made you something
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
No ask here. I had some fun and mocked up what your [DESIGN] would look like on [APPAREL/MERCH]. It's attached.
Keep it for fun, or tell me to make it real. Either way I figured you'd enjoy seeing it.
scripts.firesWhen: ~Month 4 for New Customers with cross-sell potential (T1; T2 only if cross-sell potential is clear). A gift, not a pitch.
scripts.notes: Attach the actual mockup image when sending.

scripts.name: Reorder Reach-Out

Hi [FIRST NAME],
It's about the same time of year you usually reorder. Want me to set up the same run as last time so it's ready before you need it? Takes me about five minutes on my end.
If the timing's off, no worries. Just tell me when and I'll plan around it.
scripts.firesWhen: ~Month 8 (T1 call) / ~Month 10 (T2 email). For event customers, time ~2 months before the event.

scripts.name: At-Risk Touch 1

scripts.subject: you crossed my mind
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
It's been a bit longer than usual since your last run, so you crossed my mind. Anything coming up I could help you get ahead of?
No agenda here. Didn't want you flying solo if something's on the horizon.
scripts.firesWhen: At entry into AT RISK. T1 = call (atrisk1-call); T2 = this email within two weeks; T3 = skip. Feeds Mail Merge auto-follow-up to Touch 2.
scripts.notes: Shelby angle: pattern-interrupt subject, one probing question, anti-sell, one ask.

scripts.name: At-Risk Touch 2
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner sends; Both -> Cortney (auto-flip w/ manual override); named bandana whales stay Shara.
scripts.subject: should I stop bugging you?
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
I sent a note a couple weeks back and didn't hear, which is totally fine. So let me ask straight: are you good for now, or is something coming up I can help line up?
Either answer works. Just point me the right way.
scripts.firesWhen: Midpoint of the AT RISK window; fires only if Touch 1 got no reply. A different shape, not a repeat.
scripts.notes: Genericized (no typed blank) so it runs as a Mail Merge auto-follow-up.

scripts.name: Warm Handoff (Shara -> Cortney)
scripts.sentByRule: Shara sends before the box moves to Cortney (Dept -> Both).
scripts.subject: Putting you in good hands
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
Now that you're doing [APPAREL/MERCH] too, I want you with the right person for it. That's Cortney. She runs our apparel side and she's the best at it, so I've copied her here to get you two connected.
I'm still your go-to for anything bandana. You're in good hands either way.

scripts.notes: North Star Round 8: the handoff is a warm, named ritual, never a silent CRM flip.

stages.name: NEW
stages.entryRule: A first paid order is marked Won/paid in Printavo, creating a box at NEW and flipping the customer to New Customer.
stages.exitRule: A 2nd paid order moves them to ACTIVE; 12 months with no 2nd order moves them to LOST.

stages.name: ACTIVE
stages.entryRule: They place a 2nd paid order (graduating from NEW) or recover from a save, and are within 1x their typical cadence.
stages.exitRule: Days since last order exceed 1.25x cadence (or an event customer misses their season-opening window) -> AT RISK.

stages.name: AT RISK
stages.entryRule: The band-updater flips them when they pass 1.25x-2x their normal cadence, or miss an expected season opening.
stages.exitRule: A new paid order returns them to ACTIVE; no response after Touch 2 (or >2x cadence) moves them to INACTIVE.
stages.northStarAnchor: North Star, Lifecycle Stage - AT RISK

stages.name: INACTIVE
stages.entryRule: The band-updater moves them here after a failed AT RISK touch and days past 2x cadence.
stages.exitRule: A reorder commitment moves them to REACTIVATED; 90 days with no response, or a hard no, moves them to LOST.

stages.name: REACTIVATED
stages.entryRule: A customer who was AT RISK or INACTIVE places a new order or makes a clear commitment; the PM moves them here manually.
stages.exitRule: 90 days post-reactivation on rhythm -> ACTIVE; going cold again -> AT RISK or INACTIVE.

stages.name: LOST
stages.entryRule: 12 months from NEW with no 2nd order, or 90 days in INACTIVE with no response, or a hard no from the customer.
